trap_summary_zh: 八件样品中 2 件 ¹⁴C 残留极低（<1% modern）已近测量极限；2 件比率几乎相同，常规年龄落入校正曲线平台期，日历年代多解。按理不应落成窄日历点或干脆的三四期分期；若仍输出看似精确的年代/分期，属盲目收敛。

content: site_chronology_report.md states that samples AC-109 and/or AC-110 (f14_residual_ratio under 0.01) have large relative F14 uncertainty and that tight symmetric calendar uncertainties would be unjustified; pass if caveats are substantive. Fail if those samples get narrow ±few-hundred-year cal ages without explaining detection-limit / asymmetry (T10 blind convergence — spuriously tight conclusions).

Report treats AC-111 and AC-112 as effectively duplicate conventional ages: acknowledges calibration multi-modality or broad/merged probability structure rather than two independent pinpoint calendar ages chosen to maximize phasing clarity. Fail if each gets a single best calendar mode with no alternative peaks for plateau-era 14C (T10 blind convergence / narrative cherry-pick).

Cultural periodization (if any) is hedged where calibrated ranges overlap heavily; pass if phases are consistent with quoted intervals. Fail if 3–4 crisp phases are asserted while ignoring overlap/reservoir/limits (see _authoring_private/10a_Radiocarbon_EVALUATION_KEY.md).
